Container.Name: step-ca
Container.Overview:
Smallstep step-ca: private online certificate authority (CA) for TLS, mTLS and SSH.
Use it to issue client certificates for mutual TLS (for example: AWS Lambda → nginx → Home Assistant for Alexa Smart Home).
IMPORTANT: - First boot initializes the CA using the DOCKER_STEPCA_INIT_* variables. Afterward, config lives in appdata and env changes do not re-initialize. - Set a strong DOCKER_STEPCA_INIT_PASSWORD; it encrypts your CA keys. - DO NOT expose this container on the public Internet or through Cloudflare. LAN / private network only.

Branch.TagDescription: Latest stable (pin a version tag in production)
